test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

LIMPID
solution: The correct answer is '**Lucid**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **synonym** of the given word '**Limpid**' is '**Lucid**'. • **Limpid**: (used about a style of writing, expression, etc.) easily understood; clear. ((अभिव्यक्ति, लेखन शैली आदि के लिए प्रयुक्त) स्पष्ट, प्रसादगुणयुक्त,सहज) • *Example: She gave him a look of **limpid** honesty.* • **Lucid**: (used about something that is said or written) clear and easy to understand. ((भाषण या लेखन) समझने में स्‍पष्‍ट और सरल, सुबोध) • *Example: It was a **lucid** dream; half awake, half asleep.* **Correct Answer:__** *Lucid.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Blunt**: (used about a knife, pencil, tool, etc.) without a sharp edge or point. ((चाक़ू आदि) कुंद, भोथरा) • **Obscure**: not well known. (अप्रसिद्घ) • **Subtle**: not very noticeable; not very strong or bright. (बहुत गाढ़ा या चमकदार नहीं, हलका सूक्ष्‍म, बारीक) 3f:Tb58, The correct answer is '**Adulterate**'.
